description: Designs the post- or pre-tensioning tendons of a concrete girder in the open model to EN 1992-1-1 with the Tendon Designer plugin's own engine, or reads the model's own tendons and checks them (mode improve, the default when tendons run along the girder). Reads the girder (a structure group, element list or the CIVIL NX selection; for improve it is picked from the tendons), its sections, supports and concrete, and the forces: construction-stage results when the model has stages (stage by stage for improve), else the static load cases named, plus an optional live envelope and ULS envelope combination. The girder is ONE girder line (a group holding several girders is split; girderLine picks one). Composite girders (precast + deck slab) are checked stage by stage (compositeMode) with the slab's own concrete, including the slab top; standard precast beams are pre-tensioned on their published strand positions, with debonded (sleeved) strands set or searched for by debonding, each end's length separately. Then auto-designs the layout (new), reads the tendons in (improve), or takes tendons the user gives as heights above the soffit with transverse distances (soffitTendons, e.g. an existing bridge's tendon schedule), and runs every check: stresses at transfer and in service, Magnel, load balancing, losses, ULS bending, cover, spacing, bend radius, anchorage zones. autoResolve tries the smallest change that clears failed checks. exportSoffitCsv returns the tendons as a soffit-height CSV (download link). The design is kept (designId) for tendon_write. Read-only.

autoResolve.description: When checks fail, try the smallest change that clears them (the plugin's Auto-resolve); taken only if fewer checks fail.

columnStrands.description: Strands per tendon, column by column (left to right, as design.columns lists them); null = the design's strandsPerTendon. A column with its own count is written with its own tendon property. Post-tensioned draped tendons only (not standard strand patterns).

compositeMode.description: Composite girder (precast girder + deck slab section): when the tendons are stressed. before = prestress, girder and wet-slab weight on the girder alone, superimposed dead and live load on the composite section (precast / pre-tensioned); after = the slab has hardened, prestress on the composite section too; off = ignore the slab. Default: worked out from the construction stages (first stressing stage vs the slab's CSCS stage), else before. The slab's concrete is read from the model (CSCS, else the section's Es/Ec).

compositeSection.description: Old name of compositeMode: girder = before, whole = after.

endA_m.description: Sleeved length at end A (the girder's start), m.

debonding.description: Pre-tensioned only: strands sleeved (debonded) at the beam ends so they carry no force there - relieves transfer tension at the ends. "auto" = the plugin's Find debonding on the strands as designed (pairs of inner strands, 1-6 m, within 25 % of all strands and 40 % of a row, outermost strands bonded; taken only if checks improve); "none" = every strand bonded (auto-design does not debond either); or a list giving exactly the strands to sleeve, by name as design.debonding.strandNames lists them (standard positions like "A.5", or tendon numbers on a tendon grid). Omitted: as auto-design left it (on a standard precast beam it may already debond). Written to CIVIL NX as each strand's DeBondBLEN / DeBondELEN.

elementIds.description: The girder's beam elements (one girder line).

exportSoffitCsv.description: Also return the design's tendons (new, improved or given) as the soffit-height CSV - Tendon, Station (m), Height above soffit (mm), Transverse distance y (mm), one row per point - as a download link (soffitHeightsCsv). It is the file the plugin's Heights from soffit… imports and soffitTendons.csv reads.

externalTendons.description: mode new, post-tensioned box or U girders: add external tendons in the void (CIVIL NX External tendon type), straight between deviators - anchored at the centroid, low at 0.3 and 0.7 of each span just clear of the bottom slab, high over interior supports. Added before the internal tendons are sized, so those are sized with them in place.

clear_mm.description: Clear gap from the sheath to the concrete, mm (default 50).

count.description: External tendons (placed beside each web; one at the middle when odd).

mu.description: Friction at the deviators (default 0.12, HDPE duct, EN 1992-1-1 Table 5.1; steel 0.25).

forces.description: Where the forces come from. Default: CIVIL NX - construction-stage results when the model has stages (the construction-stage analysis must have been run), else static load cases.

kind.description: On a staged model: cs (default) or static load cases.

liveMax.description: Live load envelope max, as CIVIL NX names it, e.g. "LL(MV:max)" or "SLS(CB:max)".

selfWeight.description: Static: self-weight case(s) with their suffix, e.g. ["DL(ST)"]. Default: the case named like self weight / dead.

source.description: beam = no forces read: the plugin's continuous beam with self-weight from the section plus lineLoads.

ulsEnvelope.description: A ULS envelope combination used in place of the factored sum.

includesPrestress.description: The combination already holds the prestress secondary moments (default true on a staged model).

girderLine.description: When the group/elements hold several separate girders: which one to design (1-based, as listed in girderNotes). Default: the one with the most tendons on it.

group.description: Structure group holding ONE girder's beam elements - the elements one continuous tendon runs through, end to end (not the whole deck). A group holding several girders is split into its girder lines and one is designed (girderLine).

keep.description: autoResolve: what it must not change. improve default: anchors, count, strandsPerTendon and duct kept, profile free; new default: nothing kept.

lineLoads.description: forces.source beam: superimposed dead and live line loads, kN/m.

losses.description: Loss method and inputs (default EN 1992-1-1 with Annex B creep and shrinkage). code cs455 assesses an existing UK bridge's losses to CS 455 clause 8 (8.7-8.14); the stress limits and resistance checks stay EN 1992-1-1.

creepCoefficient.description: EN 1992: a creep coefficient phi(inf, t0) in place of Annex B.

Ec_GPa.description: Concrete modulus at transfer (default Eq 3.5a, 20 + 0.27 fci).

creepPerMPa_e6.description: Creep strain per MPa x1e-6 in place of Table 8.8.3 (0 is used as entered).

elasticShortening.description: 8.11.3: half the modular ratio x the mean stress along the tendon, or (n-1)/2n.

fci_MPa.description: Cube strength at transfer (default from the grade and transfer age).

otherLosses_pct.description: Steam curing / other losses, % of the stress at transfer.

shrinkage_e6.description: Shrinkage strain x1e-6 in place of Table 8.9.1 (0 is used as entered).

wobbleK_e4.description: Wobble K x1e-4 /m (8.14.4/5: 17 rigid sheaths, at least 33 otherwise; default 33).

dryingPerimeter.description: EN 1992 h0 = 2Ac/u: outer faces only (default), or with the void faces for vented cells.

hoursOnBed.description: EN 1992 pre-tensioned: hours from tensioning to release (default 24).

loadingAge_days.description: EN 1992: age at loading t0 for creep (default 7).

psi2.description: Quasi-permanent factor on the traffic (default 0): creep and the relaxation reference stress.

shrinkageAfterStressing_e6.description: EN 1992: the shrinkage strain AFTER stressing, x1e-6, in place of Annex B.

mode.description: new = auto-design new tendons; improve = read the model's own tendons on the girder and check / improve them; given = the tendons in soffitTendons (set automatically when soffitTendons is given). Default: improve when tendons run along the girder, else new.

search.description: mode new, post-tensioned: how hard to look for the layout. fast (default, seconds) = the plugin's quick search, every tendon on one shared profile. deep = the plugin's Find the best layout - Deep: every arrangement (strands per tendon x tendons per column), each on one shared profile AND with a profile per mirrored pair of columns (outer webs, inner webs ... each with its own low points, levels over the piers and anchors), hundreds to thousands of profiles sampled then refined span by span; returns the chosen layout plus the best option of each arrangement (autoDesign.deep.options). Use deep when the user wants the best / most economical layout or tendons profiled individually.

balance.description: deep only: load balancing as the aim, as the plugin's Load balancing + Deep. Passing layouts that balance target % of the chosen load in EVERY span (within ±5 points) are ranked first, then the least strand; otherwise the closest. The aim never overrides a failing check. Each option reports its balance per span.

load.description: permanent = self-weight + superimposed dead (final force); self = self-weight; girder = self-weight + wet slab; transfer = load at transfer (force at transfer).

target.description: Target, % of that load balanced in each span.

options.description: deep: options listed (the best of each arrangement).

sectionNodeLine.description: Only when CIVIL NX will not send the section records: the node line (top, centroid, bottom) the tendon heights are measured from. Worked out from the model otherwise.

settings.description: Loads & prestress values that differ from the model / plugin defaults.

fck.description: Concrete grade fck, MPa (default: read from the material).

maxTendonsPerColumn.description: new: tendons per web column at most (default 4).

sigmaJack.description: Jacking stress, MPa (default 1395, or the model tendons' own).

strandUnits.description: new: strands per tendon to try (default 7, 12, 15, 19, 22, 27, 31).

stressing.description: Jacked from both ends, the start or the end (improve: default as in the model).

transferLength.description: Post-tensioned transfer length (default calc, in the checks). calc = each tendon's own length from EN 1992-1-1 8.10.3(5) (spread at 2 beta, beta = arctan 2/3, from the bearing plate to the top/soffit and across its share of the width); user = begin_m / end_m for every tendon; none = full force at the anchor; auto = CIVIL NX's 0.5 x (H + Bf/n). tendon_write writes it (calc and user as user defined). inChecks (default true): the design's checks build each tendon's force up linearly over it, as CIVIL NX does; false = full force at the anchor in the checks.

soffitTendons.description: Tendons given by the user - typically an existing bridge's tendon schedule - as heights of the tendon centre ABOVE THE SOFFIT at stations along the girder, with the transverse distance across the section: the plugin's Heights from soffit… input. Either tendons (each with its points) or csv (the plugin's soffit-height CSV / template: Tendon, Station (m), Height above soffit (mm), Transverse distance y (mm), one row per point; a sheet with stations across also reads). Every check then runs on these tendons as given (no auto-design), and tendon_write can write them. A full-length tendon becomes a spline through its points; a part-length tendon at a constant depth becomes a slab tendon.

csv.description: The soffit-height CSV text instead of tendons.

strandsPerTendon.description: Strands per tendon (default: the plugin's default unit, or settings).

heightAboveSoffit_mm.description: Height of the tendon centre above the soffit, mm.

station_m.description: m from the girder's start (its first node; see startNode).

transverse_mm.description: Transverse distance at this point, mm (e.g. a tendon in a sloping web).
Transverse distance from the section centroid, mm (+ as in the plugin's section view), for every point that does not give its own. Default 0.

standardStrands.description: mode new: a section named after a UK/Irish standard precast beam (Y, TY, SY, M, U, W ...) is pre-tensioned on the beam's published strand positions. false (or settings.prestressType "post") post-tensions it instead.

startNode.description: The girder end its stations are measured from (default: the end the elements run from).

useSelection.description: Use the beam elements selected in CIVIL NX (one girder line).

name: tendon_design
title: Design or check a girder's prestressing tendons (Tendon Designer)
